children: Energean's risk and reward profile is more attractive after share-price weakness over the year to date, Jefferies analyst Mark Wilson writes as he upgrades the rating on the stock to hold from underperform, and lifts its target price to 800 pence from 680 pence. Shares in the London-listed energy firm haven't risen as much as peers this year given the majority of its production is fixed-price gas for domestic use in Israel, he says. However, the company will benefit from revised tax assumptions and the development of the Katlan project in the Karish gas field offshore Israel, he adds. Shares closed Friday at 778.50 pence and are down 12% since the start of the year.  (adam.whittaker@wsj.com)
